submission.rationale: The planning evidence indicates the close request is already a tombstone (probe returned already_closed/removed=false). The owner action contract states that repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable, and the live probe confirmed exact replay returned already_closed/removed=false. The intended consequence is to converge the original close without closing a different later world state or inventing a second effect. REPLAY_EXACT does exactly this: it re-applies the exact close with the same digest against the same workspace, which is replayable and will not create a new effect, because the tombstone retains the sourceStateDigest. This avoids closing a different world state (would happen with REBASE_AND_ACT) and avoids inventing a new effect (ACT_UNBOUND/ACT_WITH_PLANNING_BINDING risk).
